feat(edm): sinker burn to depth with a single electrode

A sinker electrode tool kind (ToolKind::Electrode): diameter = face X,
width = face Y, flute_len = length below the holder, shank_len = pickup
offset; rpm 0 and a sharp face by law, refused by name at AddTool /
ChangeTool / the library reader. EDM-E10X6 joins the starter catalog.

The Sinker Burn op (OpType 41, Section::Sinker, Family::Sinker) runs on
a sinker EDM only - refused by name elsewhere. Depth is read from a
stated datum (work top, cavity floor stand-off, electrode tip at the
approach plane); a burn past the cavity floor datum, past the model's
floor, or deeper than the electrode is long is refused by name. The
machine condition's spark gap (#531, Gap only, after the sinker-kind
check) places the tip one gap above the floor. CL: approach rapid, one
feed plunge, rapid retract; golden tests/golden/sinker_burn_cavity.cl.

Verification (#290 D7): the column engine's box atom (simulate_box)
sweeps the face grown by the gap; the program verdict convicts a burn
deeper than the part's cavity. The field eye refuses an electrode by
name (no box atom there yet). The stamp digests the resolved gap.
MCP drives it through add_tool / add_operation / edit_operation /
generate / undo; a minimal op page keeps the tab law. No post (#542).

Not exercised on a real EDM control.

Fixes #541

feat(edm): sinker rough and finish with undersize from their conditions

A Sinker Burn now states its pass (single / rough / finish) and the
finished cavity size. A rough or finish reads its condition's undersize
and gap: the electrode must be the size the condition calls for, a burn
wider than the cavity is refused (past the wall), a finish that burns
short of it is refused ("leaves the cavity under size"), and the tip
stands one undersize above the finished floor. A finish whose undersize
is not smaller than the rough it follows is warned by name
(SinkerFinishOrder, advisory). The program verdict's box atom sees the
pair reach the finished size; the pair's CL is golden.

Fixes #543
